candidates.source_name: Prozorro — Ukrainian public e-procurement portal (tender search)
candidates.why_relevant: Legally mandated publication channel for all state/SOE procurement, including NBU, Oschadbank, Ukreximbank, Sense Bank, Ukrgasbank, Treasury and Diia. Tender titles, technical specs, contact persons and responsible units expose core-banking migrations, payment-hub projects, HR/consulting engagements and reorganisation programmes months before public announcement.
candidates.access_status: public, free, no login for search
candidates.legal_status: public data published under Ukraine's Law on Public Procurement
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Prefer the OCDS/openprocurement API for bulk; use the web search UI with CPV filters (48000000, 72000000, 79000000, 66000000) and buyer EDRPOU codes for targeted monitoring

закупівля консалтингових послуг реорганізація трансформація банку Ощадбанк Укрексімбанк тендер Prozorro

candidates.source_name: Prozorro / OpenProcurement public API (OCDS-compliant)
candidates.why_relevant: Machine-readable bulk access to the same central procurement database, in Open Contracting Data Standard. Enables systematic longitudinal monitoring of banking/payments IT and HR-consulting tenders by CPV and buyer, rather than ad-hoc web scraping.
candidates.access_status: public API, free; registration may be needed for write access only
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Scheduled API pull against the tenders feed, filter by CPV and buyer identifier; store OCDS releases
candidates.discovered_via_method: English technical search + snowball from Prozorro
queries_used: Prozorro open data API public procurement openprocurement documentation

candidates.source_name: DOZORRO — civic monitoring platform for Ukrainian public procurement
candidates.why_relevant: Aggregates risk indicators, monitoring reports and civic analysis of Prozorro tenders. Useful as a pointer to contested or unusual banking-sector procurements, and to the analytical toolset (BI modules, risk.dozorro.org) that surfaces which state banks are buying what.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: RSS/blog monitoring plus periodic review of the tools and risk pages
queries_used: DoZorro моніторинг тендерів державний банк Ощадбанк ПриватБанк закупівлі

candidates.source_name: BI Prozorro — public procurement analytics module
candidates.why_relevant: Qlik-based analytics over the full Prozorro dataset since 2015 (built by Transparency International Ukraine with EBRD support), enriched with state registers and OpenDataBot data. Fast way to profile a state bank's or the NBU's supplier landscape and spending trend by category, which indirectly reveals IT/organisational programmes.
candidates.access_status: public module free; professional module bipro.prozorro.org may require registration/paid access
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Manual analyst use for profiling; not scrape-friendly (Qlik). Use API for bulk instead.
queries_used: "bi.prozorro.org" аналітичний модуль BI Prozorro відкриті дані закупівель
candidates.observed_blocker: Qlik Sense front-end; heavy JS, likely unsuitable for automated fetch (hypothesis, not verified)

negative_findings.description: Searched for a dedicated procurement ('закупівлі') section on bank.gov.ua for the National Bank of Ukraine.
negative_findings.result_summary: No dedicated NBU procurement landing page surfaced in results; NBU procurement appears via its newsroom announcements and on Prozorro under EDRPOU 00032106. A dedicated page may still exist but was not located.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Collection for NBU should be anchored on Prozorro by EDRPOU plus the NBU news feed, not on an assumed tender page.

negative_findings.description: Ukrainian-language search for consulting/reorganisation/transformation tenders specifically by Oschadbank and Ukreximbank.
negative_findings.result_summary: Only generic Prozorro landing pages and aggregator company pages returned; no specific reorganisation-consulting tender was identified from search-engine results.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Such tenders are unlikely to be findable via general web search; they require faceted search inside Prozorro (buyer EDRPOU + CPV 79000000 consulting/HR) or the API. Absence here is a search-channel limitation, not evidence the tenders do not exist.

negative_findings.description: Donor/IFI procurement channels (TED, ECEPP, UNDP, UNGM, World Bank) were only found and searched in English.
negative_findings.result_summary: No Ukrainian-language mirror or interface for these donor procurement channels was identified during this run.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Ukrainian-language coverage of donor procurement may exist via local reposting (e.g. business associations, EU delegation UA pages) and remains an untested collection route.

negative_findings.description: BI Prozorro (Qlik Sense) and EBRD ECEPP (Delta) were not fetched; assessment of automation-friendliness is inference from platform type only.
negative_findings.result_summary: Both are recorded as accessible-to-analysts but of unknown automation status; not verified as blocked.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Collection design should not assume scrapability of either; treat the Prozorro API as the automation path and these as analyst-facing.

coverage_gaps.description: Only three EDRPOU codes were confirmed in this run (NBU 00032106, Oschadbank 00032129, Ukreximbank 00032112, plus branch 09305480). PrivatBank, Ukrgasbank, Sense Bank, the State Treasury, SE Diia and the Deposit Guarantee Fund codes are not yet mapped.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Build a buyer watchlist of EDRPOU codes for every state-owned bank, the NBU, Treasury, Ministry of Finance, Ministry of Digital Transformation and SE Diia, then drive all Prozorro API monitoring off that list.

coverage_gaps.description: No validated CPV code set was assembled for banking/payments IT, core banking, HR services and management consultancy.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Derive and test a CPV shortlist (48000000 software, 72000000 IT services incl. 72240000 systems analysis/programming, 79000000 business/management/HR services, 66000000 financial services) against historical Prozorro data before going live.

coverage_gaps.description: State banks run 'відбір комерційних пропозицій' outside Prozorro for law-exempt procurements; only Ukreximbank's channel was located.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Locate and register the equivalent tender/commercial-proposal pages for Oschadbank, PrivatBank, Ukrgasbank and Sense Bank.

coverage_gaps.description: Prozorro operates through accredited eMall brokers (Zakupki.prom.ua, E-Tender, SmartTender, gov.auction and others); only one aggregator and one auction domain were incidentally observed.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Enumerate the accredited broker list and assess whether any broker exposes notices or Q&A threads (e.g. tender questions pages) not easily reachable on prozorro.gov.ua.

coverage_gaps.description: USAID-successor programmes, GIZ, EU4Digital/EU4Business, EIB and Swiss/Nordic bilateral procurement for Ukrainian financial-sector TA were not covered.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a dedicated sweep over bilateral donor procurement portals and the EU delegation to Ukraine's calls page.

coverage_gaps.description: spending.gov.ua was identified but its filtering/open-data export capabilities for a specific bank counterparty were not tested.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Pilot a query on spending.gov.ua for one known state-bank IT vendor to confirm whether counterparty-level extraction is feasible at scale.

brief: The Ukrainian public-sector route is unusually rich for this cell: Prozorro is a legally mandated, fully indexed, OCDS-API-accessible record covering the NBU, all state-owned banks, the Treasury and the Diia ecosystem, and individual tender pages carry named responsible units and contact officials — organisational intelligence that precedes any press announcement. Around it sits a mature secondary layer (DOZORRO, BI Prozorro, Opendatabot, spending.gov.ua, State Audit Service monitoring) that joins procurement activity to registry changes and to actual payment execution. For leadership moves specifically, the Cabinet of Ministers, Ministry of Finance and the Rada finance committee are statutory publishers of supervisory-board competitive-selection notices, with MoF also tendering the executive-search firms themselves. The main residual gaps are operational rather than discovery-related: an EDRPOU buyer watchlist and a validated CPV taxonomy must be built, and non-Prozorro SOE 'commercial proposal' channels plus bilateral donor portals remain unmapped.
